report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with durations 63-172ms; traces show successful sub-spans across order, inventory, payment, redis, and postgres with no errors. Metrics show zero 502s and p95 checkout ~247ms. Healthy telemetry contradicts a fault hypothesis, and no current evidence establishes a bounded root cause. Logs were excluded and dependency metrics were empty, so a specific cause cannot be substantiated; hand off for further evidence.
